title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J. K. Rowling
summary: An orphan raised by unkind relatives learns on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard, and is whisked off to a boarding school of magic where he makes friends and uncovers a secret hidden inside the castle.
readIf: you want a warm, inventive school story with clever world-building and easy page-turning momentum.
skipIf: you want complex, adult-focused fantasy rather than a children's adventure.

pairings.reason: Another young hero discovers a hidden magical world and a band of friends, with a faster, funnier voice.
A quirky, witty and warm fantasy with a very different, more offbeat sense of magic.
A magic school with the cosiness stripped out: lethal, sarcastic and aimed at older readers.
